summary: Trip to Seattle canceled after a tornado carried off her farmhouse
story: On June 14 a tornado lifted our farmhouse off its foundation and set it down in a field some distance away. I was inside at the time with my dog, Toto. We are both fine, although I hit my head and had a very strange dream. The county has declared the house uninhabitable and I am staying with my aunt and uncle, so on June 16 I canceled the trip I had booked to Seattle for June 20. I had been looking forward to seeing the Emerald City. For now I have come to the view that there is no place like home, once we have one again. The airline gave me a $200 credit and nothing else was refundable.

It is declared uninhabitable until further notice.
